text:
Alex: heads up — incident bot didn't page on-call for a high-severity alert cluster starting ~1767778990. PagerDuty shows our webhook returning 502s to notify-proxy.
Alex: I'm opening this thread to coord live mitigation. Anyone on-call?
inc-bot: ALERT (high): relay.notify failed to deliver page to Jordan (502 from notify-proxy). retry_count=3.
Jordan: I'm oncall, just saw the message. Confirming I didn't get a phone page. Was only a slack alert.
Maria: I can look at the webhook logs for notify-proxy, pulling them now.
Ashley: I'll stand up manual paging if needed — can we route to manual escalation?
Robin: Reproduced — notify-proxy logs show H2 upstream 502s to /v1/pager/send around 1767778988-1767778994.
Maria: log snippet: ```ERROR notify-proxy: upstream returned 502 for POST /v1/pager/send, backend=rotor-integration, id=bc1f2a```. Looks like rotor integration (third-party) is timing out and returning 502.
Alex: Is the incident-bot supposed to fallback to SMS or secondary relay? I thought we had an automatic fallback.
Robin: Fallback rule existed but eval shows it didn't trigger: the routing policy expected 504 or timeout, not 502. It's a gap in the check.
Jordan: Customer impact: I already had a call from an SRE at acme-corp — they said they didn't get a page while their inbound metric spike triggered. Could be one customer but possibly more.
Ashley: For live mitigation: 1) enable manual escalation (I'll do now), 2) add a temporary route to vendor-b for critical pages, 3) restart notify-proxy behind a canary host to clear stale connections.
Maria: Actioning step 1: setting escalation to manual for severity>=high. Done.
Ashley: Actioning step 2: adding vendor-b route for critical tags. Creating transient rule.
inc-bot: NOTE: escalation policy switched to manual by Ashley at 1767779021.
Maria: I'll restart notify-proxy canary: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/notify-proxy -n prod --context=redwood-canary`
Robin: FYI — rotor-integration team (external) is reporting increased error rates; raised an incident on their side at 1767779010. Might be wider.
Alex: Good call on vendor-b fallback. Jordan, can you confirm pages now?
Jordan: Got a test page via vendor-b route at 1767779030. Phone and SMS both delivered. :thumbsup:
Ashley: I'll keep the manual routing until rotor is healthy or we patch the 502-handling rule.
Maria: After the restart, notify-proxy logs show healthy 200s to vendor-b and vendor-a; rotor still 502.
Robin: Patch plan: update routing logic to treat 502 as candidate for automatic fallback and add a short-circuit to mark rotor-integration unhealthy after 3 502s in 30s. I'll prepare the PR and test in staging.
Alex: Can someone post quick customer-impact summary for support and ops? We need to track which accounts might have missed paging and outreach plan.
Jordan: Acme-corp confirmed missed page; also saw support ticket #7892 indicating a missed alert from beta-customer. I'll collect and add to the incident ticket.
Ashley: Outreach: I'll ping SE leads for affected accounts and propose an apology + short RCA once we have root cause.
Maria: Metrics: alert fanout shows ~42% of pages retried via slack only, ~24 failed initial deliveries during the window. I'll export details to the incident ticket.
inc-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: incident/2026-03-18-notify-paging-fallback. Severity: high. Owner: Alex.
Robin: PR for routing fix drafted: `git diff` summary in the incident ticket. Will request expedited review.
Alex: Good work. Keep manual fallback until PR is live and rotor team confirms recovery. After we have stable fix, we should retroactively run a test harness to verify no missed pages in next 72h.
Jordan: I'll monitor on-call deliveries and report back in 15m.
Ashley: Leaving manual routing in place for now. Will coordinate rollback once Robin confirms.
Maria: Added logs + exports to incident tracker.
Alex: Thanks team — updating pagerduty and support channels. If anything new, post here.
Jordan: Confirmed clean delivery at 1767779058, vendor-b still healthy.
inc-bot: RESOLVE TRIGGER: external rotor-integration shows partial recovery; auto-fallback still enabled manually. Pending PR review.
Alex: Leaving this thread open until PR merged and we verify 24h stability.
